Mark Carney’s government is adding tens of billions to the debt and deficit to spur the economy, ease affordability pressures and eradicate homelessness, The Canadian Press reports.
White Rock RCMP are seeking witnesses and video footage of a home invasion that happened on the evening of Nov. 1, CityNews Vancouver reports.
Trump signs proclamation making Oval Office, Cabinet Room national monument, The Hill reports.
Nithya Raman ousts incumbent Karen Bass in LA mayor’s race, CBS News projects, CBS News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
